n: ACS Controller, iSTAR Ultra G2 Controller for 8 readers
d: iSTAR Ultra G2 Controller for 8 readers, inclusive wall mount power centre for iSTAR Ultra G2 8 readers. Single enclosure with 2 x 12V 8A power supplies. Combines fixings for iSTAR Ultra GCM G2 and 2 x ACM G2 with power for controllers, locks and readers. Houses 2 x VRLA batteries up to 17Ah capacity.
